title: FZ3B 语义视频检索 PS 组件（板上编译 + 自检，真实用户项目）

args: set -e; gcc -Wall -Wextra -O2 -o read_clock PS/read_clock.c; gcc -Wall -Wextra -O2 -o mjpeg_source PS/mjpeg_source.c; gcc -Wall -Wextra -O2 -march=armv8-a+simd -c PS/native/cnn_v10_native_quant_neon.c -o cnn_neon.o; echo BOARD_BUILD_OK

verifiers.title: 板上自检（构建完整性 + 非根权限语义；ort_runner 需 /root 下 onnxruntime SDK，非本构建范围）

args: test -x read_clock && test -x mjpeg_source && ./read_clock >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 2 ]; then echo 'TESTS_PASSED'; echo 'PERM_GUARD=ok (non-root /dev/mem denied as designed)'; elif [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo 'TESTS_PASSED'; echo 'PERM_GUARD=root-context'; else echo "UNEXPECTED_RC=$rc"; exit 1; fi
